note: The two sets are effectively identical in content: both capture the PID blade-pitch law (Eq. 7-10), the inverse-proportionality of generator torque to generator speed in Region 3, and the two torque formulas (Eqs. 7-6 and 7-7) with the same conditions and quotes. Both make the same error in the PID law, writing the derivative term as K_D·N_Gear·ΔΩ when the page shows K_D·N_Gear·ΔΩ̇ (rotational acceleration). Both also omit the first-order Taylor expansions of Eqs. (7-8) and (7-9). Since the sets differ only in how the TGen entity is labeled, they are equally good.
remarks: Both sets drop the dot on ΔΩ̇ in the derivative term of Eq. (7-10), turning the acceleration feedback into speed feedback — a systematic extraction error worth flagging. Both also leave out Eqs. (7-8) and (7-9), the linearized generator- and aero-torque perturbation expressions, which are the key results of the Taylor expansion described on the page.
